حَذَّآءٌ A maker of sandals: whence the prov., “مَنْ يَكُ حَذَّآءً تَجُدْ نَعْلَاهُ
” [He who is a maker of sandals, his pair of sandals is good]. (TA. [Freytag (Arab. Prov. ii. 665) gives it thus: مَنْ يَكُنْ أَبُوهُ حَذَّآءً تَجُدْ نَعْلَاهُ He whose father is a maker of sandals, his pair of sandals is good.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
